mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.source_type, o.contract_id, o.applicant_id, o.handler_id, o.total_amount, o.status, o.apply_time, o.complete_time, o.dept_id, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, ct.contract_no, c.customer_name, au.nick_name as applicant_name, hu.nick_name as handler_name from biz_stock_order o left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = o.contract_id left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id left join sys_user au on au.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_user hu on hu.user_id = o.handler_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_stock_order (order_no, order_type, source_type, contract_id, applicant_id, handler_id, total_amount, status, apply_time, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{sourceType}, #{contractId}, #{applicantId}, #{handlerId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{applyTime}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
